name: smwmusic-boards-of-canada-dawn-chorus-bass-remix
title: Boards of Canada - Dawn Chorus (bass remix)
description:
This remix was done using a custom bassline I've found to be fitting with the song and a rhythm found in a bootleg song by the band.

It also brings little variations in the flute and choir lines as well as some octave changes.

Very satisfying, serene vibes, useful for chill levels where flying or clouds are involved.

And that's one more song I was able to cover by ear! Now I find it pretty addictive to listen to.
